scripts.build: sh -c 'attempt=1; while ! prisma migrate deploy; do if [ $attempt -ge 5 ]; then echo "Prisma migration failed after $attempt attempts"; exit 1; fi; wait_seconds=$((attempt * 5)); echo "Prisma migration attempt $attempt failed; retrying in ${wait_seconds}s..."; sleep $wait_seconds; attempt=$((attempt + 1)); done; next build'
